newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle up $1 at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle up $1 at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 38,700 slaughter steers and 21,100 heifers following the weekly movement of 21,800 head.
Note - All cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 70.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 70.00.
